atlases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for a 2D hand-painted gothic dark fantasy game, crisp fine brushwork and dark contours, emerald jade ivory and dark bark palette, one restrained rich green accent, readable at 1080p. Create EXACTLY 12 equal columns by 5 equal rows, 60 isolated full-body sprites. Wide canvas aspect12:5, target3072x1280. NO text, labels, grid, backdrop, floor, contact shadows. Actual transparent alpha.
Every sprite faces RIGHT, consistent identity and body scale across its row. At least 10% transparent padding inside EVERY cell on ALL sides: all anatomy, weapons, trails fit entirely inside cell; never overlap a neighbor. Body centered x50%, feet at y88%. Floating sprites bottom at same anchor.
Columns1-3 = 3 different movement poses; columns4-6 = 3 clearly progressive anticipation/windup poses; columns7-9 = 3 attack action poses; columns10-12 = 3 recovery poses. Each is a distinctly drawn pose, not repeated images. Each row has exactly12sprites.
Row1 bark_mantis: compact bark-armored mantis with a leaf-edged forearm scythe. Walks; draws scythe back high over shoulder, then horizontal sweep, then relaxes.
Row2 acorn_hopper: leaf-tailed hopping forest rodent wearing acorn helmet, vine sling forelimbs. Hop cycle; crouches and pulls vine sling progressively taut; throws one acorn, follows through, recovers. No extra projectiles outside cell.
Row3 pollen_wasp: emerald hovering wasp with pollen-bulb abdomen and seed proboscis. Wingbeat cycle; arches seed proboscis back and bulges abdomen; spits one pointed seed; recovers. Clearly hovering, not on ground.
Row4 silk_lantern: floating lantern spider suspended beneath a pale silk balloon, hanging seed sacs. Drifting cycle; visibly contracts balloon and gathers one sac; drops wrapped web seed from underside, recovers. Floating silhouette.
Row5 thorn_boar: squat dark-bark boar with ivy tusks, thorn spine and powerful short legs. Walk cycle; braces hooves, lowers head/tusks, compresses body; shoulder-charges right with short contained green wind smear; brakes and recovers.
Keep polished anatomical consistency, small readable complete silhouettes, fine gothic organic ornament. Prioritize exact12x5 grid and cell isolation.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for hand-painted gothic dark fantasy 2D game. Rich emerald jade ivory and dark bark, a single restrained green accent, crisp dark fine brushwork, readable high-resolution anatomical detail.
EXACT12 equal COLUMNS by4equal ROWS,48complete isolated full-body sprites, target3072x1024 wide3:1. Actual transparent alpha, no background, no ground/shadow/text/labels/grid. Every cell has at least10% empty transparent margin each side; all blades, legs, projectiles and effects must stay within its cell. Characters face RIGHT; feet/bottom anchor x50% y88%, fixed body scale across all frames and both rows of same character.
Each row EXACT12poses: columns1,2,3=three movement-cycle poses;4,5,6=three distinct progressive windup/anticipation poses for THAT row's attack;7,8,9=three active attack poses;10,11,12=three recovery poses. Never duplicate an image for multiple columns.
Rows1 and2 show the SAME thorn_duelist: an elegant tall emerald mantis knight made of bark and leaf armor, ivory face, two hooked thorn scythes and leaf cape. Row1 movement is hopping; windup crosses both hooked scythes overhead then spreads arms; active performs two close scythe cuts, recovery uncrosses and lowers blades. Row2 same appearance/movement; windup takes one leaf blade behind shoulder and curls other scythe down; active throws a contained crescent leaf right, follows through, recovery raises empty forearm. The two attacks have obviously different windup silhouettes.
Rows3and4 show the SAME loom_matron: a large low bark-and-silk armored spider with two heavy fang forelegs, multiple grounded legs and a woven abdominal spindle. Right-facing side silhouette. Row3 walking poses; windup rears fang forelegs up/back, opens fangs, active drives a short forward bite with foreleg stabbing, recovery lowers forelegs. Row4 walking poses; windup anchors forelegs and winds the abdominal spindle upward, active lobs a single wrapped web seed rightward from spindle; recovery unwinds sac. Distinct attack anatomies, no extra limbs appearing.
Preserve identities and polished hand-painted organic gothic ornament. No giant effects that hide the body. Exact12x4 layout and spacious complete silhouettes are mandatory.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent projectile and attack-effect sprite atlas for hand-painted gothic dark fantasy 2D forest game. Fine painterly texture, dark readable contours, emerald jade ivory and dark bark palette, one restrained luminous green accent. EXACTLY8equal COLUMNS by6equal ROWS (48 isolated effect sprites), target2048x1536 or equivalent4:3canvas. True transparent alpha. No text, labels, numbers, grid, background, ground plane, shadows, weapons or characters. At least10% transparent padding inside eachcell. Effects NEVER overlap neighboring cells.
Rows1-4 are projectiles centered exactly in each cell. Small short painted dust/shadow trail points LEFT, object remains clearly visible, varying trail curl can indicate spin. Eight sequential distinct authored rotations per row. Two selected frames can use carefully controlled directional brush blur on trailing edge, never an opaque disk.
Row1 acorn: detailed dark-brown acorn with ivy-wrapped cap and jade glint, eight counterclockwise tumbling orientations through full360degrees. Clear different silhouette every frame.
Row2 seed_needle: thin ivory sharpened seed needle with green serrated leaf fins. Nose always points RIGHT while the shaft rolls COUNTERCLOCKWISE along its long axis across8views; visibly alternate leaf fin upper/lower planes and light. Do not tumble the nose around.
Row3 web_seed: almond-shaped wood seed wrapped with ivory spider silk and dark green winding threads. Eight CLOCKWISE full360tumbling poses, tiny silk threads/dust trail left.
Row4 leaf_crescent: sharp curved emerald leaf crescent with visible golden midrib, eight CLOCKWISE full360tumbling orientations; prominent hooked silhouette, two blurred-edge frames.
Row5 melee_fx: eight sequential frames of a bright ivory-green crescent close-range leaf slash effect, starting thin buildup, widening sweep, breaking into leaf fragments and fading. Each frame one independent complete crescent effect centered in cell, not connected to neighbors.
Row6 trap_fx: eight sequential frames of a grounded organic thorn-and-silk trap growing from a small dark bark root base. Fixed base at cell bottom y88% and centered x50%; seed swelling, shell opening, thorn growth, full armed thorn cage, pulsing final poses. It must visibly be PLANTED with roots, not a floating bullet/orb. No ground background.
Use exact8x6 order, high detail, complete silhouettes, ample cell separation.

notes: Some active projectiles or scythes approach cell borders; normalize per-cell pivots and crop carefully.
Silk lantern balloon spider mainly front-view silhouette while seed release reads downward.
Leaf crescent quarter-turn poses are visually distinct after targeted edit; runtime clockwise angle can reinforce intermediate motion.
All original images retained without downscaling.

regular.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for a hand-painted gothic dark fantasy 2D action game. Tall portrait sheet, EXACTLY SIX equal columns and TEN equal rows, 60 isolated small character poses. No drawn grid or text. Every character RIGHT-facing, full body, tiny centered subject occupying at most 42% of its cell width and 50% height INCLUDING arms/weapons; at least 22% transparent empty padding each side. Bottom of feet near 80% cell height. Identity and scale locked across poses. Palette emerald jade, ivory highlights and dark bark, crisp fine ink contours with painterly shading. ONLY creature bodies and their attached anatomy: absolutely NO emitted projectiles, slash waves, particles, glows, trails, ground or shadows. Each pair of rows is ONE species, in this exact order: rows 1-2 compact bark-armored mantis with a short leaf scythe; rows 3-4 hopping forest rodent with acorn helmet, leaf tail, vine sling forearms; rows 5-6 emerald wasp with pollen bulb abdomen and narrow seed proboscis; rows 7-8 small lantern spider suspended from a silk balloon with hanging seed sacs; rows 9-10 stout natural-proportioned bark boar with ivy tusks, thorn spine and short strong legs. Within each ODD row columns 1-3 are three movement poses (alternating feet or wing beats), columns 4-6 three increasingly clear windup poses. Within each EVEN row columns 1-3 are three attack body poses, columns 4-6 three recovery body poses. Mantis draws scythe backward then sweeps its attached arm forward; rodent crouches/pulls sling then releases with empty hands; wasp arches proboscis then contracts abdomen; spider contracts balloon then opens seed-sac anatomy but DOES NOT DRAW THE DROPPED POD; boar braces hooves, lowers tusks, leans bodily forward without stretching or motion blur then brakes. Full silhouettes MUST stay completely inside each cell, all six bodies separated by large transparent gaps on every row. Do not make subjects large. True transparent alpha. Target portrait ratio 6:10, high quality 1536x2560 if supported.

elite.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent production character sprite atlas, portrait 6:8 ratio, EXACT SIX columns and EIGHT rows, 48 isolated small sprites. Every sprite must be a TINY complete character in the CENTRAL THIRD of its equal cell: at most 45% cell width and 48% height including weapons, enormous empty transparent spacing, minimum22% clear gap at every edge. All characters RIGHT-facing and feet on common cell baseline80%. No cell borders or text. ONLY ACTUAL CHARACTER BODIES AND ATTACHED WEAPONS; absolutely no detached projectile, slash wave, particle, trail, glow, ground, cast shadow or motion streak. SAME anatomy/size across phases. Rows1-4 are one mantis duelist knight: slim bark armor, two short hooked thorn scythes, short leaf cape. Rows1-2 attackA, row1 columns1-3 movement then4-6 windup crossing scythes overhead, row2 first3 active close scissor cuts then last3 recovery. Rows3-4 attackB: row3 first3 movement thenlast3 windup drawing one leaf blade behind shoulder, row4 first3 throwing gesture with EMPTY hand, last3 recovery; do NOT draw the thrown leaf. Rows5-8 are one armored forest spider keeper: bark and silk carapace, two fang forelegs, woven abdominal spindle. Rows5-6 attackA, row5 movement3 then windup3 rearing fang forelegs; row6 biting forward3 then recovery3. Rows7-8 attackB, row7 movement3 then windup3 winding abdominal spindle; row8 active3 abdominal release gesture WITHOUT ANY EMITTED POD, then recovery3. Anatomical attack gestures only. Natural proportions, never stretched. True transparent alpha. Aim 1536x2048. Keep sprites genuinely SMALL rather than maximizing fill.

qa.note: Six per row. No embedded FX/projectiles. Source row spacing NOT equal: use row_bounds+padding instead of uniform heights. Prefer alpha projection gaps for columns. Regular second row third/fourth scythe poses nearly touch.
